titulo: Valero Refinery Penalty: $2.85M vs $1.8B to Stockholders
caption:
Valero Refinery Penalty: $2.85M vs $1.8B to Stockholders

Valero refinery penalty vs. what Valero said. 2020 10-K: it seeks "to find ways to reduce the environmental impact of all of our operations." Same year, the EPA settled alleged Clean Air Act violations at 11 refineries: $2.85 million civil penalty. Also in 2020: $1.8 billion returned to stockholders.

Sources: Valero 10-K 2020; EPA settlement page, Oct 19, 2020.

descripcion:
Valero refinery penalty, side by side with what Valero said. In its 2020 annual report (the 10-K, the yearly filing every public company sends the SEC), Valero says it continually seeks "to find ways to reduce the environmental impact of all of our operations."

What did the EPA find? On Oct 19, 2020, the EPA announced a settlement resolving alleged Clean Air Act violations on fuel quality at 11 Valero refineries and one import facility. The Clean Air Act is the US law that limits air pollution, including what goes into gasoline and diesel. Valero agreed to a $2.85 million civil penalty, the fine paid to the government.

Also in 2020, Valero says it returned $1.8 billion to its stockholders.

They said, they did: all three numbers come from Valero's own filing and the EPA's settlement page.

Sources: Valero Energy Form 10-K for 2020; EPA, Valero Clean Air Act settlement, Oct 19, 2020.
